summary: Backend testing completed for 5 bug fixes in Rahaza Travel Fleet Management ERP. Tested driver double-booking prevention (FIX A), cancel state-machine guard (FIX B), timezone-aware timestamps (FIX C), confirm re-validation (FIX D), and dispatch re-assign vehicle freeing (FIX E). Overall: 4 out of 5 fixes working correctly, 1 fix (FIX E) has a bug where old vehicle is not freed after re-assignment.

critical_bugs.fix: FIX E - Dispatch re-assign frees old vehicle
critical_bugs.issue: When re-assigning a booking to a different vehicle, the OLD vehicle status remains 'on_trip' instead of being freed to 'available'
critical_bugs.expected_behavior: After re-assigning booking to vehicle2, vehicle1 should be set to status='available' if no other active trips/bookings use it
critical_bugs.actual_behavior: vehicle1 remains in status='on_trip' after re-assignment
critical_bugs.impact: Old vehicles appear busy when they are actually free, blocking availability for new bookings
critical_bugs.test_evidence: Test #31 showed vehicle1 status='on_trip' after re-assign (expected: 'available')

working_fixes.fix: FIX A - Driver double-booking prevention via PATCH
working_fixes.details: PATCH /api/bookings/{id} correctly rejects assigning a driver who has overlapping active bookings (HTTP 400 with 'bentrok' message). Non-conflicting drivers and non-overlapping bookings are accepted (HTTP 200).

POST /api/bookings/{id}/cancel correctly rejects cancelling completed bookings (HTTP 400 with 'selesai' message). Cancelling already-cancelled bookings is idempotent (HTTP 200, no duplicate refund payments). Normal confirmed bookings can be cancelled successfully.

working_fixes.fix: FIX C - Timezone-aware timestamps in cancel
working_fixes.details: After cancelling with refund, both booking.cancelled_at and refund payment.paid_at are timezone-aware ISO strings ending with '+00:00' (e.g., '2026-07-04T21:00:29.990575+00:00'). No naive timestamps found.

POST /api/bookings/{id}/confirm correctly validates conflicts. The system prevents driver conflicts at booking creation time (even better than catching at confirm). Confirm with no conflicts works correctly (HTTP 200).

items.issue: FIX E - Old vehicle not freed after dispatch re-assign
items.description: When re-assigning a booking to a different vehicle via POST /api/dispatch/{booking_id}/assign, the old vehicle's status remains 'on_trip' instead of being freed to 'available'. The code checks for other active trips and bookings, but the old vehicle is not being freed even when no conflicts exist.
items.suggested_fix: Review the logic in dispatch.py assign_trip function. The check at lines 178-185 should free the old vehicle, but it's not working. Possible issues: (1) The booking might still reference the old vehicle_id when the check runs, (2) There might be a trip record still pointing to the old vehicle, (3) The query conditions might be too strict.
items.test_to_verify: Run Test #31 in backend_test.py - after re-assigning booking to vehicle2, vehicle1 should have status='available'
